column1: # Motion Prompt catalog (en) · 216 elements · https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/ · columns: id
column6: summary
An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.
Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.
A like heart fills in, and a ring, lines and dots burst outward at the same moment.
A chart line draws itself on, and is later erased from its starting end.
Headline text slides out from behind an invisible edge marked by a single line.
Text is typed into an input field one character at a time, then the send button lights up and is pressed.
A number races upward and locks onto its final value.

column4: Kinetic typography (キネティックタイポグラフィ)
column6: Words move the way they mean: one stretches, one bounces, one spins, one slams down.
Two squares cover the same distance in the same time: the top one at constant speed, the bottom one eased.
A gauge needle swings past its target, comes back and settles.

column4: Squash & stretch (スクワッシュ＆ストレッチ)
column6: A bouncing character squashes on landing and stretches as it takes off.
A shape changes smoothly from circle to square to star to heart, with its colour.

column4: Liquid motion (リキッドモーション)
column6: A blob stretches out, breaks into drops and merges back into one.

column4: Motion trail (モーショントレイル)
column6: A ball moving in a figure eight leaves a fading trail of copies behind it.
Particles keep shooting up from an emitter, spread out and fall.
A landscape pans sideways; near layers move more and far layers move less, creating depth.

column4: Mask transition (マスクトランジション)
column6: A circle- or star-shaped window grows, showing the next scene inside it.

column4: Shape transition (シェイプトランジション)
column6: Coloured bands sweep across and cover the frame; when they leave, the next scene is there.

column4: Liquid transition (リキッドトランジション)
column6: Paint-like liquid drips down from the top and fills the frame, becoming the next scene.
The camera pushes into the hole of a letter O and comes out in the next scene.
A card turns over around its vertical axis and shows its other side.
A band of light crosses the surface of a logo badge at an angle.
Text slices shift sideways, colours split and small bars appear, with no brightness flashing.

column4: Impact shake (インパクトシェイク)
column6: A heavy headline slab drops with a thud and the whole frame shakes from the impact.
The camera stays in place and pivots from left to right; because it is a rotation, near and far layers slide sideways by the same amount.
The camera stays in place and pivots upward, from a person at ground level up to the top of a tower.

column5: dolly,dolly in,push in,track in,move forward,parallax,camera move
column6: The camera itself moves toward the subject; near objects grow and pass quickly while the distant mountains barely change.
The camera does not move; only the focal length gets longer, so the whole picture enlarges by the same ratio.
The camera moves sideways at the same speed as a walking person; the person stays centred while nearer posts sweep past faster.
The camera travels on a circle around the subject; the person stays centred while the trees and buildings behind sweep sideways.
The camera rises while tilting down until it looks down on the person.
The camera pulls back while zooming in by the same ratio; the person keeps the same size and only the background closes in.

column4: Rack focus (ラックフォーカス)
column5: rack focus,focus pull,pull focus,depth of field,blur,bokeh,foreground
column6: The camera does not move; focus shifts from a flower in the foreground to a person behind it, swapping which one is blurred.
Adds a small, irregular shake to the whole frame, as if the camera were held by hand instead of on a tripod.
A first-person view flying low and fast between two rows of trees, banking from side to side.
A level camera rolls around its lens axis and holds with the horizon on a diagonal.

column4: Slow motion (スローモーション)
column6: In front of a fixed camera a person rises and falls slowly through a jump while leaves drift down slowly; the whole action is stretched out.

column5: speed ramp,time remap,ramping,fast to slow,variable speed,velocity
column6: Within one shot the playback speed changes smoothly from fast to slow; a graph at bottom left shows the speed.
With a fixed camera, 06:00 to 18:00 is compressed into a few seconds; sun, clouds, people and shadows move in fast forward.

column4: Freeze frame (フリーズフレーム)
column6: The picture stops at the moment a jumping person reaches the top, then resumes from the same frame 1.4 s later.
Camera position and framing stay the same while the person's position and the clock jump; time is skipped inside one scene.
A thrown ball becomes, in the next shot, a sun at the same position and size; two different scenes are joined on a matching shape.
The camera swings sideways very fast and the next scene is swapped in during the streaked blur.

column4: Cross dissolve (クロスディゾルブ)
column6: The next picture is laid over the current one and its opacity rises until it takes over; both show through each other midway.
A vertical edge moves from left to right and the next picture replaces the current one behind it.

column4: Smash cut (スマッシュカット)
column6: A quiet scene of a person asleep cuts with no warning straight to an intense one; the volume meter jumps at the same moment.

column5: j-cut,j cut,split edit,audio lead,sound first,audio transition,edit
column6: The next scene's audio starts before the picture changes; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.

column5: l-cut,l cut,split edit,audio lag,sound carries over,audio transition,edit
column6: The previous scene's audio carries on for a while after the picture has changed; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.
Clicking "Open" dims the whole page and a small window scales up slightly into the centre; clicking × closes it.
Clicking "Menu" slides a tall panel in from the left; clicking outside slides it back.
A finger taps "View details" and a panel rises from the bottom; dragging its handle down closes it.
Clicking the first of three headings opens its content and pushes the rows below down; clicking again closes it.
Clicking the field opens four options below it; picking "Nagoya" closes the list and fills the field.
Hovering over a "?" icon shows a short note in a dark bubble above it; it disappears when the cursor leaves.
Clicking "Details" opens a small white panel to its right with a pointer at the button; clicking OK inside closes it.
Clicking "Save" slides a dark notice into the bottom-right corner; when its time bar runs out it slides away.
Clicking the tabs "Overview, Pricing, Reviews" in turn slides a blue underline across and swaps the content below.
Each click on the right arrow slides a row of three different images one step to the left, and the dot below moves.
The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.

column4: Segmented control (セグメントコントロール)
column6: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.
Clicking the "New" and "Free" chips adds a check mark and turns them blue, and cards that do not match fade out.

column4: Range slider (レンジスライダー)
column6: On a price slider, the left handle is dragged right and the right handle left to narrow the range, then both go back.
Pressing + three times raises the number from 1 to 4, and pressing − three times brings it back to 1; the number pops on each press.
Clicking 2 and then 3 in the page numbers moves the blue circle and swaps the list above; finally it goes back to 1.

column4: Hamburger menu (ハンバーガーメニュー)
column6: Clicking the three-line icon at the header's right turns it into ×, and a menu drops down from under the header; clicking again closes it.
Clicking "Courses" in the breadcrumbs goes up to the list page; clicking a card there returns to the detail page.
Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.

column4: Step indicator (ステップインジケーター)
column6: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.
Clicking reload turns the list into grey blocks of the same shape with a sweeping shine; the content returns when loading ends.
Clicking "Send" washes the card white and a blue arc spins in the middle; when finished it changes to a check and fades.
Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.

column4: Empty state (エンプティステート)
column6: Deleting the two list rows with their trash icons brings up an empty-box drawing, "Nothing here yet" and an "Add" button.

column4: Parallax scrolling (パララックススクロール)
column6: As the page scrolls down, the headline moves up normally while the sky and sun, far hills and near hills move more slowly.

column4: Fade-in on scroll (スクロールでフェードイン)
column6: As the page scrolls, the heading, the cards and the body text each rise into place and fade in when they enter the view.
The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.
A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.
As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.

column4: Scroll snap (スクロールスナップ)
column6: After a small scroll, the page carries itself the rest of the way until the next section's top lines up with the top of the view.

column4: Scroll progress bar (スクロールプログレスバー)
column6: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.

column4: Highlighter animation (マーカーアニメーション)
column6: As the copy scrolls into view, a yellow highlighter stroke is drawn left to right across the lower half of the key words.

column4: Hover lift (ホバーで浮き上がる)
column6: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.

column4: Image zoom on hover (ホバーで画像ズーム)
column6: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.

column4: Cursor follower (マウスストーカー)
column6: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.

column4: Magnetic button (マグネティックボタン)
column6: As the cursor comes near, the button is drawn toward it and follows; when the cursor leaves, the button wobbles back to its place.

column4: Ripple effect (リップルエフェクト)
column6: Each click sends a white circle out from the click point to fill the button, then it fades away.

column4: Underline animation (下線アニメーション)
column6: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.

column4: Before/after slider (ビフォーアフタースライダー)
column6: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.

column4: Exit-intent popup (離脱防止ポップアップ)
column6: When the cursor heads out through the top of the page (toward the tabs and close button), the page dims and a "Wait!" popup opens. The × closes it.
On a navy screen the number under the logo counts from 0% to 100%; then the screen lifts away and the page underneath fades in.
As grey placeholders scroll into view, a spinner turns in each, and the images fade in as they arrive. The top row is loaded from the start.
Scrolling down to the end of the list brings up a spinner, then three new items are added so reading can go on.

column4: Page transition (ページ遷移アニメーション)
column6: Clicking a card in the work list sweeps an orange panel across from the left; the URL changes and the panel exits to the right on the detail page. "Back to list" returns the same way.

column4: Smooth scroll (スムーススクロール)
column6: Clicking "Pricing" in the menu glides the page down to the pricing section; the up arrow at the bottom right glides it back to the top.
Inside a navy band, large service names separated by orange dots keep moving to the left without a gap.

column4: Animated gradient (グラデーションアニメーション)
column6: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.

column4: Floating animation (ふわふわアニメーション)
column6: Next to the headline, a phone, a heart badge and a rating chip each bob gently out of step, and the shadow under the phone grows and shrinks.
The sun moves from outside the frame to directly behind the person's head; a thin bright edge appears around the figure, a pale warm haze covers the frame and the side facing the camera darkens.

The surroundings go dark and two lights behind the person, left and right, draw thin bright edges only along both sides of the head and shoulders; the plan at the bottom right shows where the two lights are.
As the exposure is set for the bright evening sky, the person, buildings, lamp and tree turn into flat black shapes with no detail and only the sky stays bright.

column4: Split lighting (スプリットライティング)
column6: The light swings from near the front (20°) to directly at the side (90°); the shadow on the head grows from a crescent to exactly half, splitting the face down the middle.

column4: Rembrandt lighting (レンブラントライティング)
column6: A light 45° to the side and 45° up comes on; the right side of the face falls into shadow except for a small inverted triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.

column4: Butterfly lighting (バタフライライティング)
column5: butterfly lighting,paramount lighting,beauty lighting,portrait lighting,overhead light,glamour
column6: A light in front of the face and high above comes on; the face lights evenly on both sides and only a small symmetrical shadow falls under the chin.

column4: Golden hour (ゴールデンアワー)
column5: golden hour,magic hour,sunset light,warm light,long shadows,low sun
column6: The sun drops to just above the horizon; sky and ground turn orange, the left side of the person lights up and the shadows of the lamp and tree stretch far to the right.
Once the sun has set, the sky turns two bands of deep blue, the windows and street lamp come on in amber and the person becomes a dark blue shape.

column5: bokeh,shallow depth of field,background blur,wide aperture,f/1.4,out of focus,lights
column6: As the aperture opens, the in-focus person stays sharp, the buildings behind soften and the street lamps and distant lights spread into large, pale discs.

column5: tilt-shift,miniature,miniature effect,fake miniature,selective focus,toy town,focus band
column6: The top and bottom bands of the street blur while only the middle band with the road, the car and the small people stays in focus, so the street looks like a model.

column5: long exposure,light trails,slow shutter,night photography,car trails,motion
column6: The street turns to night; the moving car fades to almost nothing, a red tail-light line stretches out behind it and white and amber lines run along the opposite lane.
The camera follows the moving car: the car stays sharp in the middle of the frame while only the buildings, trees and lamps behind it streak sideways.
As the sun comes out from behind a building, rays appear around it and a line of light dots, hexagons and a ring runs from the sun through the centre of the frame to the opposite side.
The middle of the street scene bulges out; the vertical lines of the buildings and the lines of the road bow outward while the corners stay where they are.

The street scene is split into red, green and blue and the three are laid back together at slightly different sizes, so red and cyan fringes appear on the edges of the person, buildings and lamps, larger towards the sides.
The frame darkens smoothly from the corners while the person and the road in the middle stay bright.
The landscape and the person turn to light, near-white colours with very faint shadows, and the hump of the histogram at the bottom right moves to the right end.
Most of the frame sinks into darkness and the sun goes out; only the right edge of the bust, lit from the side, stays bright. The histogram hump moves to the left end.
The colour drains from the same landscape; the sun and the light on the figure turn grey and the shapes read only by their brightness.
The colours of the same landscape are replaced by a range between just two colours: indigo in the darks and pink in the lights.

column4: Teal and orange (ティール＆オレンジ)
column5: teal and orange,orange and teal,cinematic,color grading,blockbuster,film look
column6: In the same landscape the sky, hills, ground and the shadowed figure shift to teal while the sunlit edge of the figure and the sun shift to orange, a complementary contrast.

column4: Film grain (フィルムグレイン)
column6: Fine grain appears over the whole of the same landscape and the colours lean slightly towards a warm cream.
From the right edge of the same landscape a band of leaked light comes in, pale yellow on the inside and red at the edge, swaying slowly.

column4: Double exposure (二重露光（多重露光）)
column6: The background turns white and the landscape of hills, house, trees and sun appears, scaled down, only inside the shape of the bust.

column4: Anticipation (アンティシペーション)
column6: A square character pulls back against its direction of travel, squashes to wind up, then shoots forward.
A round character slides in and stops suddenly; only the flag on its head and its tail keep swinging, then settle.
A ball drops and bounces lower each time until it comes to rest.
A bell keeps jittering irregularly: not one hit, but a small shake that never stops.
A heart throbs like a heartbeat, a double beat each time, with rings spreading out.
A paper plane follows a dotted path, turning as it goes and looping the loop on the way.
A square travels to one end, then comes back along the same path as if played in reverse, again and again.

column4: Stop-motion style (ストップモーション風)
column6: A star hops across in choppy steps at about 8 frames per second, each frame slightly off.

column4: Text scramble (テキストスクランブル)
column6: Random characters keep changing, then lock into the right word from left to right.

column4: Wave text (ウェーブテキスト)
column6: The letters of "WAVE TEXT" rise and fall one after another, like a wave.

column4: Text on a path (テキストオンパス)
column6: A line of text flows along a wavy line, each letter turning to follow it.

column4: Variable font animation (可変フォントアニメーション)
column6: The same word goes smoothly from thin to very bold and back, with a slider below showing the weight.
Heavy letters are cut out so that a moving seascape shows only inside them; near the end of the cycle the whole picture appears.
One shape is duplicated around a circle, and the copies turn and pulse slightly out of step.
An 8-way symmetrical pattern turns and spreads out from the centre, like a kaleidoscope.
A hand-drawn line picture wobbles every few frames while the picture itself stays still.
The next scene slides in from the side and pushes the current one out with it.
Gaps in a row of thin strips widen until the next scene is fully open.
Like a turning cube, the front face swings away and the next face comes round.
A page peels back from its corner and folds over, revealing the next page beneath.
The picture turns into coarser and coarser blocks, switches at the coarsest point, then sharpens again.
The picture cracks like glass, the shards fly off and the next scene is revealed.
A phone separates into its layers to show how it is built, then assembles again.

column4: Split screen (スプリットスクリーン)
column6: One full-frame scene splits into two panels, then three, each with its own scene moving.

column4: Timeline on scroll (タイムラインアニメーション)
column6: As the page scrolls down, an orange line grows down the timeline; each dot it reaches fills in and its year and event slide in from the right. Scrolling back up reverses it.

column4: Scroll text reveal (スクロールテキストリビール)
column6: A light gray headline darkens one character at a time from the top left as the page scrolls, and fades back from the end when scrolling up.

column4: Stacking cards (スタッキングカード)
column6: On scroll, the next card rises from below and stacks over the previous one with a small offset; the cards underneath shrink a little and darken.

column4: Background color change on scroll (背景色の切り替え)
column6: Each time the scroll moves into a new section, the whole page background blends from cream to navy to light blue; on the dark background the text turns white.
Scrolling down slides the header up out of view to free the screen; scrolling up even a little brings it straight back.
As the article scrolls, the table-of-contents item for the section being read lights up, and the highlight moves on when the next heading comes in.

column4: Back-to-top button (トップへ戻るボタン)
column6: After scrolling down, a round arrow button appears at the bottom right; clicking it takes the page straight back to the top.

column4: Zoom on scroll (スクロールで拡大)
column6: As the page scrolls, a small photo in the middle grows to fill the window, the text around it fades away and a headline appears over the photo.
As the cursor moves over the card, the card tilts in depth to match the cursor position and a glare moves across its surface; it settles flat when the cursor leaves.

column4: Spotlight hover (スポットライトホバー)
column6: As the cursor moves over the dark cards, only a circle around it is lit, and the edges of nearby cards glow.

column4: Image swap on hover (ホバーで画像切り替え)
column6: With the cursor on a product card, the front photo of the T-shirt cross-fades to a back view; it returns to the front when the cursor leaves.

column4: Text roll on hover (テキストロール)
column6: With the cursor on a menu word, its letters roll up and out one by one while the same word rolls in from below in orange; it rolls back when the cursor leaves.

column4: Hover image reveal (ホバーで画像プレビュー)
column6: With the cursor on a row of a text-only list, that row's photo fades in beside the cursor and follows it.

column4: Floating label (フローティングラベル)
column6: Clicking the field shrinks the label and moves it onto the top border, leaving the field free for typing; empty and unfocused, the label moves back inside.

column4: Inline validation (インラインバリデーション)
column6: While the email address is half typed the field turns red with an "invalid format" message; the moment it is complete it switches to a green check and "OK".

column4: Loading button (ローディングボタン)
column6: Clicking the submit button shrinks it to a circle with a spinner inside; when it finishes it widens into a green "Done" with a check.

column4: View transition (shared element) (ビュートランジション)
column6: Clicking a photo in the list grows that same photo into the image at the top of the detail page while the rest changes to the detail page; going back shrinks it into place.
Clicking a thumbnail in the gallery dims the page and shows that photo large in the center; the × shrinks it back into its thumbnail.
White dots pulse on the product picture; clicking one opens a tooltip about that part, and clicking another dot swaps the tooltip.

column4: Countdown timer (カウントダウンタイマー)
column6: The hours, minutes and seconds under "キャンペーン終了まで" (until the campaign ends) count down every second; only the digits that change slide up and out as new ones come in from below.

column4: Animated shape divider (シェイプディバイダー)
column6: Where a blue section meets a white one, two layered wave shapes keep swaying slowly.

column4: Like button animation (いいねアニメーション)
column6: Clicking the heart fills it red with a springy pop, small particles burst around it and the count beside it goes up by one; clicking again undoes it.

column4: Scroll-down cue (スクロールダウンの合図)
column6: Below the hero, the word "SCROLL", a dot inside a mouse outline and arrows on either side keep repeating a downward motion.
In the hero background, clouds and waves keep moving, while the headline and button sit still on top.
The camera moves straight up without changing its direction; the horizon stays centred while the person and buildings slide down.
The camera rolls a full turn around its lens axis; the horizon goes all the way round and comes back level.
The camera travels forward along a street while the sun, clouds and passers-by run in fast forward: a time-lapse that moves.

column5: long take,oner,one shot,continuous,no cut,sequence shot,camera move
column6: One continuous shot follows a walking person with no cut; the bar at the bottom stays a single unbroken strip.
The camera glides forward after a walking person with only a slow, gentle sway and no jitter, unlike handheld.

column4: Follow shot (フォローショット)
column6: The camera trails a weaving walker along the same path a few metres behind; the person stays near the centre, seen from the back.
A person crosses in front of a tripod-fixed camera and a car passes behind; the camera does not move by a pixel.
The camera flies toward a wall with a window, passes through the opening and comes out into the place beyond.
The camera drops to near the ground and looks up; the person looks big and the buildings tower.
The camera rises and looks down; the person looks small and the ground fills most of the frame.
Seen through a character's eyes: the walking sway and the hands at the bottom say first person, and the person ahead waves at you.

column4: Over-the-shoulder (オーバーザショルダー)
column6: The back of one person's head and shoulder sit at the edge of frame and the other person is seen past them; the foreground is soft, the subject sharp.
Looking straight down from overhead: road, people, cars and trees appear as top-down shapes, and more comes into view as the camera rises.

column4: Deep focus (ディープフォーカス)
column5: deep focus,depth of field,everything sharp,f/16,small aperture,pan focus,focus
column6: From the flower in front to the person and buildings behind, everything comes into sharp focus at the same time.

column4: Establishing shot (エスタブリッシングショット)
column6: A wide, high view of the whole town; the camera pushes in slowly and a location caption appears at bottom left.

column4: Extreme close-up (エクストリームクローズアップ)
column6: From a close-up of the face to a frame filled by nothing but the eyes.

column4: Insert shot (インサートショット)
column6: A big close-up of the watch on the person's wrist is cut into the scene for 1.3 s, then it returns to the same shot.
Two takes of the same person are joined by smoothly interpolating position and pose, so nothing jumps as in a jump cut.

column4: Fade to black (フェードアウト)
column6: The whole picture sinks to black, and the next scene brightens out of the black.
A circle closes down on the person until the frame is black, then opens again on the next scene.
From the speaker to the listening audience and back; what is cut in is a different subject.
Two scenes happening at the same time, a runner and a car, alternate in shorter and shorter cuts.
Time nearly stops at the top of a jump while the camera circles around the person.
Seven short shots show thirty days of training; straight cuts, with the date jumping at top right.
The line drawing of a house, a tree and the sun becomes a pale transparent watercolor, with colors bleeding and pooling and the white paper left showing.
The same line drawing becomes a richly colored oil painting with thick paint; brush strokes and knife marks stand out as ridges.
The same line drawing becomes a picture in one black ink on washi paper, shaped only by dark and pale ink, bleeds and soft washes.

The same line drawing becomes an Edo-period color woodblock print: the house turns into a tiled-roof Japanese house, the tree into a pine, the sun into a red circle, and the sky fades from deep indigo at the top.
The same line drawing becomes a picture made only of dots of color; sky, house, tree and ground are all built from clearly visible, fairly large dots.
The same line drawing becomes a hand-drawn colored pencil picture, with layered fine strokes and white paper grain showing through.
The same line drawing becomes a black-and-white print from a carved block, made only of bold lines and shapes with no gray or blur.
The same line drawing becomes a glass picture divided by black lead lines; sky, hill, house and tree each turn into pieces of colored glass with light shining through.
The same line drawing becomes flat primary colors with bold black outlines, with halftone dots here and there.
The same line drawing becomes glowing neon tubes on a dark brick wall; the house, tree, sun and the line of the hill glow and bloom.
The same line drawing becomes a gold-and-black poster: straight rays spread out from the sun, and geometric straight-line ornament is arranged almost symmetrically.
The same line drawing becomes a poster from around 1900: outlines turn into flowing thick curves, and leaves, grass and sun rays become ornaments of vines and flowers around the house and tree.
The same line drawing becomes a print in two inks, yellow and teal; the two layers overlap slightly out of register, with ink grain and paper texture visible.
The same line drawing becomes many layers of cut colored paper; shadows fall where the layers step, giving depth.

column4: Flat illustration (フラットイラスト)
column6: The same line drawing becomes a picture made only of flat areas of color, with no outlines and no shadows.
The same line drawing becomes a detailed drawing in one dark navy pen on cream paper, with every roof tile, leaf, blade of grass and sun ray drawn in line.

column4: Pixel art (ドット絵（ピクセルアート）)
column6: The same line drawing becomes a flat, game-style picture made of square pixels, with no depth and every pixel clearly visible.
The same line drawing becomes a 3D diorama of stacked small cubes; the house, tree, sun and hill are all made of cubes with light on top and shade on the sides.
The same line drawing becomes 3D made only of triangular faces; each face has its own shade, so the forms look faceted.
The same line drawing becomes a photo of models folded from colored card stock: the house is a box, the tree and sun are polyhedra, and folds, glue tabs and cut edges show.
